fixture.name: account-desk
setup: graph-agents-cli api add accounts_rpc --protocol jsonrpc --base-url-env ACCOUNTS_RPC_URL --auth bearer --token-env ACCOUNTS_RPC_TOKEN --access custom --methods POST

prompt: In account-desk/, the agent must never close accounts. Make the accounts JSON-RPC API refuse the account.close method, whatever path or label a call gives it. Keep everything else as it is.

checks.expr: any(isinstance(d, dict) and str(d.get('rpc_method', '')).lower() == 'account.close' and not d.get('path') and not d.get('operationId') and not d.get('methods') for d in (get(data, 'apis.accounts_rpc.denied_operations') or []))
checks.why: the client reads the JSON-RPC method from the request body: a denial by rpc_method alone (`api deny NAME --rpc-method account.close`) refuses it whatever the path or label

checks.expr: get(data, 'apis.accounts_rpc.allowed_methods') == ['POST'] and not get(data, 'apis.accounts_rpc.allowed_operations') and get(data, 'apis.accounts_rpc.protocol') == 'jsonrpc' and len(get(data, 'apis.accounts_rpc.denied_operations') or []) == 1
checks.why: only the one denial is added; everything else the API allows stays

reference: `graph-agents-cli api deny accounts_rpc --rpc-method account.close` (--dry-run first): one denied_operations entry {rpc_method: account.close}, which refuses the method whatever path or operation label a call gives it. A denial by operationId (closeAccount) only refuses calls that carry that label: account.close sent under another label gets past it. Nothing else changes; `lint` passes.
